description: Output of RPC /bee.v1.OpsService/TailOpsLogs: `data` is a bee.v1.OpsLogEntry in proto3-JSON. `bee ops tail-ops-logs --json` prints one such document per streamed message, one per line (NDJSON); a failure ends the stream with an error document. Errors print a document matching schemas/v1/error.schema.json.
title: bee ops tail-ops-logs
